name: University College London (UCL)
header:
University College London (UCL)
United Kingdom · Mathematics MPhil/PhD; separate LSGNT four-year CDT dossier
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• RES needs a separate cover sheet and research proposal despite ordinary mathematics proposal exemption.
• UELA international applicants restricted to collaborative projects.
• Official transcripts required at initial stage; UCL rejects unofficial screenshots and freezes submitted
documents.
• Do not mistake older research group text about Zerbes for a current UCL supervision appointment.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Minimum UK upper-second bachelor in relevant field or overseas equivalent: UChicago mathematics bachelor
is a valid degree type subject to grades. Department says successful applicants usually have MSc/MSci at
merit/distinction; master preferred in practice, not formal universal minimum. International applicants eligible;
shortlisted interview. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Identify and informally contact one or more potential supervisors; names must be included in departmental
application. Prepare official transcripts, passport, statement and two referees. Discuss whether proposal
required. For RES prepare CV/proposal and separate cover sheet; UELA uses separate project application. [s2]
[s4] [s5] [s12]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Required to state proposed supervisors; contact them informally before applying. Ed Segal expressly directs
prospective PhD students to LSGNT. Faculty below verified shortlist; current openings not promised. [s2] [s16]
[s17]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Maximum2graduate courses per cycle; documents frozen after submission except requested additions; portal
manages reference status and offers. Verify name exactly as passport and all documents before submit. [s1]
[s9] [s12]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Programme,RES,UELA explicitly 2027-28. Some departmental research summaries still mention departed
faculty (e.g.Zerbes nowETH); verified current roster and papers used below. [s1] [s4] [s5] [s15] [s17]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
October 2027:30June 2027 17:00UK; opens19October 2026. Department recommends November/December
for funding. February 2028:29October 2027 17:00UK. Prospectus prints May 2028 deadline 28January 2027, an
unusually early year that must be confirmed rather than silently corrected. [s1] [s2]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
RES: complete admission application plus cover sheet to department by 8January 2027; exact clock not
specified and department may impose earlier cutoff. UELA:8January 2027 noonGMT; strongly recommends

application and both references by 16December 2026 due holiday closure. LSGNT:separate31December 2026
23:59London. [s4] [s5]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Ordinary final rule:17:00UK on tenth working day after programme closes; for 30June 2027 closing, weekday
arithmetic yields14July 2027 absent an intervening institutional closure (derived, verify). Funding requires
complete application earlier: RES8January; UELA8January noon with16December recommended. [s4] [s5] [s8]

English evidence may follow initial application, but must satisfy offer before entry; no fixed graduate-wide date
verified. Do not import undergraduate1September deadline. [s7] [s12]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Submit correct versions with initial application. Documents cannot be added/replaced after submission unless
UCL requests them. RES requires completed admissions file and cover sheet by 8January 2027; exact final
qualification deadline is offer-specific. [s4] [s9] [s12]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal published acceptance deadline established; applicant portal/offer controls. RES decisions by
mid-March 2027. [s4] [s9]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Level1:IELTS6.5 overall/6.0 each; TOEFL from 21January 2026 4.5overall/4.0each, earlier
TOEFL92overall,reading/writing24,listening/speaking20. Evidence within2years of enrolment; September 2027
tests on/after 1September 2025. [s1] [s7]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Non-majority-English nationality must provide evidence, but completion of at least12months English-medium
academic education leading to an awarded qualification in an approved country can satisfy requirement.
Qualification awarded within2years before enrolment; whole course must have been completed in
majority-English-speaking country. A completed UChicago degree is the intended education route subject to
these dates; F-1 alone is irrelevant. [s7]

policy not found; do not send unsolicited extras. [s1] [s2] [s9]

unresolved. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Academic records
sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Official registry-issued transcript required; interim acceptable during current study. Must show
institution/name/modules/grades, institutional heading and issuing-office authentication; unofficial
departmental transcripts/screenshots rejected. English translations by institution/registered translator only.
Final records show award/date; add certificate if absent. Upload in Education; files
under5MB,PDFpreferred(.docx/.jpeg/.jpgallowed),unencrypted. Secure direct transcript service
alternative:upload explanation then registrar sends to transcripts.pgadmissions@ucl.ac.uk. [s10] [s11]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
Transcript modules required; separate math-course list not specified for ordinary PhD. LSGNT separately
requires topic list. [s11] [s12]

Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No separate ordinary PhD course-description requirement found; do not upload additional documents unless
requested. [s9] [s11]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two; at least one academic degree-level teacher, second academic or professional. Current undergraduate
should obtain academically informative letters. [s1] [s8]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
RES reuses references from admission application; no extra third letter specified. UELA separately requires two
references in its competition. Scholarship-specific exact referee questionnaire not established. [s4] [s5]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Automatic email at submission; entering details alone is not described as triggering requests. Use
academic/professional email. [s8]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes. Applicant portal access follows validation, normally within72hours, for tracking/resend/replacement. [s8]
[s9]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Applicant portal displays reference status. If resend option remains, reference not yet received. UCL does not
chase missing letters for applicant. [s9] [s10]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Replace referee/edit contact only before response; resend at most once/24h. Reference links valid30calendar
days and can be reissued until deadline. UCL will not transfer letters from previous applications or accept extra
letters. Correction of an already-submitted letter requires direct admissions instructions; not established
publicly. [s8] [s9] [s10]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
Ordinary research guide allows CV for work/experience but department does not state universal CV
mandate/length. RES explicitly compiles CV from admissions file: upload one if applying RES; exact page/font
limit unverified. [s4] [s12]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Personal statement:online3,000characters including spaces, or uploaded document maximum
2A4pages,12-point,single-spaced. Faithful paraphrase: explain research/course motivation, UCL fit, academic
interests/preparation, relevant work/activities and career aims. Confirm portal requirement for particular PhD
route. [s13]
Personal / background statement [Unresolved]
No distinct additional background essay specified; personal statement above covers relevant experiences. [s12]
[s13]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Identify proposed supervisor(s) and interests in application; no separate additional essay limit specified beyond
statement/proposal guidance. [s2] [s13]
Research proposal [Conflict]
Mathematics says usually unnecessary; discuss with supervisor. Central research guide calls it required
generically. RES specifically collects proposal from admission file, so prepare for that competition. Faithful

paraphrase: proposed area, existing understanding and research question. Mathematics-specific proposal
length/format unverified. [s2] [s4] [s12]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Unresolved]
No thesis/writing-sample requirement found. Unrequested extra documents are not added or assessed after
submission; do not assume papers may be uploaded. [s9] [s12]

No separate mandatory publications list found. Include appropriate record in CV when requested;
upload-versus-link rule for papers not established. [s4] [s12]

application and project catalogue; verify project-specific prompts before drafting. [s4] [s5] [s18]

Current passport copy for visa applicants; missing-passport form permitted if passport unavailable. Interview
for shortlisted candidates. No additional ordinary math short answers verified. [s1] [s12]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
Teaching assistantship:tuition+stipend for 4years;2027 stipend amount not stated. RES:full Home/Overseas
fees,maintenance2027TBC(prior 2026/27£23,805/year),up to£1,200/year research costs. UELA:2027
estimate£26,022/year (£1,500 above expectedLondonUKRI£24,522),full fee-gap award for selected
international students and research grant. [s3] [s4] [s6]
Years of support [Standing rule]
TA4years with compulsory teaching; RES normally3years research-only, no writing-up/CRS year, subject to
progress (4years only integratedprogramme standardresearchlength); UELA4years with thesis expected within
funding. [s3] [s4] [s6]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
RES all countries/HomeOverseas. UELA caps international cohort15of~50(30%); ONLY collaborative projects
open overseas, standard projects Home-only; ensure relevant mathematics project is eligible before investing.
TA public page says tuition but overseas fee coverage must be explicitly confirmed. [s3] [s4] [s5]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Funding highly competitive. TA compulsory teaching with training. RES academic/research merit and
supervisory/project fit, financial hardship not criterion; satisfactory progress. UELA project-specific
selection/degree requirements and four-year submission expectation. [s3] [s4] [s5] [s6]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
TA automatically considered; RES separate cover sheet/notification (not merely automatic). UELA separate
SurveyMonkeyApply project application; LSGNT separate central application. [s3] [s4] [s5]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
LSGNT joint funded route is particularly aligned; Martingale has UK-background/income restrictions needing
individual check. Heilbronn listing in department page is 2026-27 viaStatisticalScience, not
confirmed2027mathematics award. [s3]

Application fee [Standing rule]
Research degree applications exempt from application fee. Standard£90taught fee does not apply to this PhD.
[s14]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Not needed for research-degree application because fee-exempt. [s14]

text:
University College London (UCL)
United Kingdom · Mathematics MPhil/PhD; separate LSGNT four-year CDT dossier
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• RES needs a separate cover sheet and research proposal despite ordinary mathematics proposal exemption.
• UELA international applicants restricted to collaborative projects.
• Official transcripts required at initial stage; UCL rejects unofficial screenshots and freezes submitted
documents.
• Do not mistake older research group text about Zerbes for a current UCL supervision appointment.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Minimum UK upper-second bachelor in relevant field or overseas equivalent: UChicago mathematics bachelor
is a valid degree type subject to grades. Department says successful applicants usually have MSc/MSci at
merit/distinction; master preferred in practice, not formal universal minimum. International applicants eligible;
shortlisted interview. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Identify and informally contact one or more potential supervisors; names must be included in departmental
application. Prepare official transcripts, passport, statement and two referees. Discuss whether proposal
required. For RES prepare CV/proposal and separate cover sheet; UELA uses separate project application. [s2]
[s4] [s5] [s12]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Required to state proposed supervisors; contact them informally before applying. Ed Segal expressly directs
prospective PhD students to LSGNT. Faculty below verified shortlist; current openings not promised. [s2] [s16]
[s17]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Maximum2graduate courses per cycle; documents frozen after submission except requested additions; portal
manages reference status and offers. Verify name exactly as passport and all documents before submit. [s1]
[s9] [s12]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Programme,RES,UELA explicitly 2027-28. Some departmental research summaries still mention departed
faculty (e.g.Zerbes nowETH); verified current roster and papers used below. [s1] [s4] [s5] [s15] [s17]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
October 2027:30June 2027 17:00UK; opens19October 2026. Department recommends November/December
for funding. February 2028:29October 2027 17:00UK. Prospectus prints May 2028 deadline 28January 2027, an
unusually early year that must be confirmed rather than silently corrected. [s1] [s2]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
RES: complete admission application plus cover sheet to department by 8January 2027; exact clock not
specified and department may impose earlier cutoff. UELA:8January 2027 noonGMT; strongly recommends

application and both references by 16December 2026 due holiday closure. LSGNT:separate31December 2026
23:59London. [s4] [s5]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Ordinary final rule:17:00UK on tenth working day after programme closes; for 30June 2027 closing, weekday
arithmetic yields14July 2027 absent an intervening institutional closure (derived, verify). Funding requires
complete application earlier: RES8January; UELA8January noon with16December recommended. [s4] [s5] [s8]
Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
English evidence may follow initial application, but must satisfy offer before entry; no fixed graduate-wide date
verified. Do not import undergraduate1September deadline. [s7] [s12]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Submit correct versions with initial application. Documents cannot be added/replaced after submission unless
UCL requests them. RES requires completed admissions file and cover sheet by 8January 2027; exact final
qualification deadline is offer-specific. [s4] [s9] [s12]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal published acceptance deadline established; applicant portal/offer controls. RES decisions by
mid-March 2027. [s4] [s9]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Level1:IELTS6.5 overall/6.0 each; TOEFL from 21January 2026 4.5overall/4.0each, earlier
TOEFL92overall,reading/writing24,listening/speaking20. Evidence within2years of enrolment; September 2027
tests on/after 1September 2025. [s1] [s7]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Non-majority-English nationality must provide evidence, but completion of at least12months English-medium
academic education leading to an awarded qualification in an approved country can satisfy requirement.
Qualification awarded within2years before enrolment; whole course must have been completed in
majority-English-speaking country. A completed UChicago degree is the intended education route subject to
these dates; F-1 alone is irrelevant. [s7]
GRE General [Unresolved]
Not listed in mathematics entry or research application documents. Explicit not-considered/optional-score
policy not found; do not send unsolicited extras. [s1] [s2] [s9]
GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
No mathematics GRE requested in checked mathematics admissions pages; explicit consideration policy
unresolved. [s1] [s2]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Official registry-issued transcript required; interim acceptable during current study. Must show
institution/name/modules/grades, institutional heading and issuing-office authentication; unofficial
departmental transcripts/screenshots rejected. English translations by institution/registered translator only.
Final records show award/date; add certificate if absent. Upload in Education; files
under5MB,PDFpreferred(.docx/.jpeg/.jpgallowed),unencrypted. Secure direct transcript service
alternative:upload explanation then registrar sends to transcripts.pgadmissions@ucl.ac.uk. [s10] [s11]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
Transcript modules required; separate math-course list not specified for ordinary PhD. LSGNT separately
requires topic list. [s11] [s12]

Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No separate ordinary PhD course-description requirement found; do not upload additional documents unless
requested. [s9] [s11]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two; at least one academic degree-level teacher, second academic or professional. Current undergraduate
should obtain academically informative letters. [s1] [s8]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
RES reuses references from admission application; no extra third letter specified. UELA separately requires two
references in its competition. Scholarship-specific exact referee questionnaire not established. [s4] [s5]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Automatic email at submission; entering details alone is not described as triggering requests. Use
academic/professional email. [s8]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes. Applicant portal access follows validation, normally within72hours, for tracking/resend/replacement. [s8]
[s9]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Applicant portal displays reference status. If resend option remains, reference not yet received. UCL does not
chase missing letters for applicant. [s9] [s10]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Replace referee/edit contact only before response; resend at most once/24h. Reference links valid30calendar
days and can be reissued until deadline. UCL will not transfer letters from previous applications or accept extra
letters. Correction of an already-submitted letter requires direct admissions instructions; not established
publicly. [s8] [s9] [s10]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
Ordinary research guide allows CV for work/experience but department does not state universal CV
mandate/length. RES explicitly compiles CV from admissions file: upload one if applying RES; exact page/font
limit unverified. [s4] [s12]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Personal statement:online3,000characters including spaces, or uploaded document maximum
2A4pages,12-point,single-spaced. Faithful paraphrase: explain research/course motivation, UCL fit, academic
interests/preparation, relevant work/activities and career aims. Confirm portal requirement for particular PhD
route. [s13]
Personal / background statement [Unresolved]
No distinct additional background essay specified; personal statement above covers relevant experiences. [s12]
[s13]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Identify proposed supervisor(s) and interests in application; no separate additional essay limit specified beyond
statement/proposal guidance. [s2] [s13]
Research proposal [Conflict]
Mathematics says usually unnecessary; discuss with supervisor. Central research guide calls it required
generically. RES specifically collects proposal from admission file, so prepare for that competition. Faithful

paraphrase: proposed area, existing understanding and research question. Mathematics-specific proposal
length/format unverified. [s2] [s4] [s12]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Unresolved]
No thesis/writing-sample requirement found. Unrequested extra documents are not added or assessed after
submission; do not assume papers may be uploaded. [s9] [s12]
Publications list [Unresolved]
No separate mandatory publications list found. Include appropriate record in CV when requested;
upload-versus-link rule for papers not established. [s4] [s12]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No separate ordinary-route written course list verified; required transcript already contains modules. [s11] [s12]
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
RES: notify department and submit Research Scholarships cover sheet by 8January 2027 (earlier internal
deadline possible); department extracts CV,proposal,transcripts,references from admission file. Cover-sheet
landing page opened but DOCX returned403, so exact internal questions/limits unresolved. UELA has separate
application and project catalogue; verify project-specific prompts before drafting. [s4] [s5] [s18]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Current passport copy for visa applicants; missing-passport form permitted if passport unavailable. Interview
for shortlisted candidates. No additional ordinary math short answers verified. [s1] [s12]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
Teaching assistantship:tuition+stipend for 4years;2027 stipend amount not stated. RES:full Home/Overseas
fees,maintenance2027TBC(prior 2026/27£23,805/year),up to£1,200/year research costs. UELA:2027
estimate£26,022/year (£1,500 above expectedLondonUKRI£24,522),full fee-gap award for selected
international students and research grant. [s3] [s4] [s6]
Years of support [Standing rule]
TA4years with compulsory teaching; RES normally3years research-only, no writing-up/CRS year, subject to
progress (4years only integratedprogramme standardresearchlength); UELA4years with thesis expected within
funding. [s3] [s4] [s6]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
RES all countries/HomeOverseas. UELA caps international cohort15of~50(30%); ONLY collaborative projects
open overseas, standard projects Home-only; ensure relevant mathematics project is eligible before investing.
TA public page says tuition but overseas fee coverage must be explicitly confirmed. [s3] [s4] [s5]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Funding highly competitive. TA compulsory teaching with training. RES academic/research merit and
supervisory/project fit, financial hardship not criterion; satisfactory progress. UELA project-specific
selection/degree requirements and four-year submission expectation. [s3] [s4] [s5] [s6]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
TA automatically considered; RES separate cover sheet/notification (not merely automatic). UELA separate
SurveyMonkeyApply project application; LSGNT separate central application. [s3] [s4] [s5]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
LSGNT joint funded route is particularly aligned; Martingale has UK-background/income restrictions needing
individual check. Heilbronn listing in department page is 2026-27 viaStatisticalScience, not
confirmed2027mathematics award. [s3]

Application fee [Standing rule]
Research degree applications exempt from application fee. Standard£90taught fee does not apply to this PhD.
[s14]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Not needed for research-degree application because fee-exempt. [s14]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Central proposal mandate vs mathematics usually-not-needed; RES does require proposal. Prospectus May
2028 deadline printsJanuary 2027 - flag rather than correct. Older UELA URL404redirected to new
DoctoralSchool page; portal confirms2027deadline and international collaborative-only rule. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s5]
[s12]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Ask math.pgrtutor@ucl.ac.uk about RES internal deadline,proposal limits,TA annual stipend and international
fee coverage; inspect RES DOCX and UELA project-specific prompts; confirm final offer deadlines and transcript
authentication accepted for UChicago e-transcript. [s3] [s4] [s5] [s11] [s18]
